verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a GenAI DDQ feature with autofill automation for questionnaires and the ability to upload previous questionnaires to a library, so it ingests questionnaires in some form. Nothing shows support for specific formats (SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets) or export back in the customer's original format. Missing for 10: documented import of SIG/CAIQ/spreadsheet/portal questionnaires, format-preserving export, portal integration, any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, questionnaires arrive in every shape — SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets — and the platform imports and exports them in the format the customer sent

citations.quote: How to Use the Autofill Automation for Questionnaires ... How to Upload Previous Questionnaires to Library
